The '''Hook Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Santarine]] was within the nebula. [[Qeimet fleet]] was based near there.

==History==
At the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the nebula was considered a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and had its own [[Moff/Legends|Moff]].<ref name="TEA-OC" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Hook Nebula was subjugated by the Empire's [[Qeimet fleet]] during the [[Hook Nebula campaign]], despite widespread local support for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Scimitar assault wing]] played a major role in this victory, with its commander [[Tomax Bren/Legends|Tomax Bren]] earning the nickname "White Death" for his actions.<ref name="AJ15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>
